msg: If you are right-handed use "s" key with index finger of left hand. Press "space" key with index finger of your right hand.     Use "k" keys if you are left-handed. Press "space" key with index finger of your left hand. Don't be put off if you get "Too Slow" message just continue with your fingers on the keys you feel comfortable with. Don't think too much on how many mushrooms you pick you will find out when you finish.
